label: GO-only a1 drive: belief S1 good plus a1-unrewarded last trial, fading over episode
terms: (phase == GO) * (1 - ep_trial/120) * np.tanh(belief_lo/2) ;; (phase == GO) * (1 - ep_trial/120) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * (1 - ep_trial/120) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * (1 - ep_trial/120) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * (1 - ep_trial/120) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (1 - ep_trial/120) * last_is("a2 S1 r")
explanation: hidden/88 is active essentially only at GO (D1/D2 ~0). Beyond timing, its GO magnitude rises with the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good (graded, tanh(belief_lo/2)) and with the previous trial: largest after a1 S2 u (rare unrewarded, MB says repeat a1), then a1 S1 u, a1 S1 r; generic prev_action==a1 gets a negative weight (so a1 S2 r is low), and a2 S1 r is lower still. All terms are scaled by (1 - ep_trial/120), because the effects shrink as the episode goes on in parallel with the decaying timing baseline; this multiplicative scaling raised dev R2 beyond timing from 0.43 to 0.47. Two-trial-back model-based votes, belief_cover, and even the actual (future) choice added <0.01. Dev R2 beyond timing 0.467 vs all-observed reference 0.55 and all ceiling 0.62; the earlier model-based explanation used the policy logit (policy decile alone 0.42), and the observed-only belief+history version recovers about that much, so little is lost by dropping model outputs. Remaining misses: early-episode GO steps with large activations where the ideal observer is still uncertain.
